caption: The drawing features three views of a chair rendered in black lines on a beige or light tan background. At the top left, there is an overhead plan view of the chair, showing the outline of the seat and the curved contours of the backrest. Below it, a front elevation view displays the chair head-on, revealing four curved legs, a contoured seat, and a decorative, waisted backrest framed by an arched outline. On the right side, a side elevation shows the chair in profile, highlighting the backward inclination of the backrest, the curved legs, and the thickness of the seat cushion. Dotted lines indicate the alignment of the different views. Below the side view, a horizontal scale marked "Scale of Inches" is included for reference. Dimensions for various parts of the chair are labeled in small text near the corresponding sections. The drawing is contained within a larger rectangular border centered on the page. There is no shading or coloring apart from the pale background and black outline.
title: Chair
